question: A ‘Nattuvanar’ conducts a ______ dance recital.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Bharatanatyam.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatnatyam was performed by certain families of the Tanjore district and these inheritors were known as 'Nattuvanar'.**
 
• The** term nattuvanar connotes a man who accompanied the devadasi dance in the capacity of a dance master, music conductor, and vocal percussionist.**
 
• **Bharatnatyam** is one of the most popular** classical Indian dances.**
 
• **Bharatnatyam is more popular in the South Indian states of Tamil Nadu and Karnataka.**
 
• Bharatanatyam is the** oldest classical dance tradition** in India.
